name: Michael Milch

bio.statement: The Oregon Blue Book lists Milch as mayor of Gladstone.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State (Oregon Blue Book)

bio.statement: Milch's pamphlet statement lists work as a consulting pension actuary (1989-2008) and church educator/administrator (1975-1989).
Milch's pamphlet statement lists a mathematics B.A. from U.C. San Diego and a religious education M.A. from Claremont School of Theology.
bio.excerpt: U.C. San Diego, Mathematics, B.A; Claremont School of Theology, Religious Education, M.A

bio.statement: Milch's pamphlet statement lists Gladstone service as mayor, city councilor, planning commissioner and budget committee chair.
bio.excerpt: City of Gladstone: Mayor, City Councilor, Planning Commissioner, Budget Committee Chair.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Milch says the city continues to attract new businesses to develop local destinations.
positions.excerpt: Beyond these civic investments, we continue to attract new businesses to develop local destinations

positions.statement: Milch's pamphlet statement says much has been accomplished in the four years since he was elected mayor.
positions.excerpt: Much has been accomplished in the four years since I was elected Mayor of Gladstone.
